title: Steam account data and game saves (Flatpak)
whyItMatters: The Flatpak build keeps its own copy of Steam account data, saves and screenshots inside the sandbox, so a native-only check will miss it.
source: Flatpak sandbox permissions: per-app data lives in ~/.var/app/<app-id>/data; Steam's Flathub id is com.valvesoftware.Steam: https://docs.flatpak.org/en/latest/sandbox-permissions.html
notes: Same numeric per-account layout as the native install. Some Flatpak setups also place a Steam tree in ~/.var/app/com.valvesoftware.Steam/.steam.
